messages:
jordan: Quick check-in: NexusSI asked for a marketplace listing, SSO (SAML), SCIM, and KMS (HSM) certification. Can we outline what's required for the listing and a safe rollout plan?

marta: High level: we need a verified connector badge for the marketplace, a partner docpack (onboarding + limitations), an integration test report (SCIM + KMS), and a co-marketing blurb. Also pricing/sku info from partnerships.

liam: For KMS certification I'll need: access to a test HSM endpoint, an integration build (REST), and a set of test vectors for keywrap/unwrap. ETA: I can run lab tests in 10 business days if we get access this week.

jordan: SSO/SAML: do we require IdP metadata exchange before listing, or can we do a "certified with manual setup" flag?

marta: Prefer requiring basic SAML metadata for the badge. For SCIM we can have an automated badge if they pass our SCIM CI suite. Otherwise mark as "manual provisioning supported."

liam: Important note: NexusSI's connector supports KMIP and REST for keys. We should certify REST for marketplace v1 and explicitly list KMIP as "enterprise-only, contact support."

tanya: Marketing wants a short description and one hero screenshot for the listing. Also need a 2-sentence co-announcement and partner logo (SVG). I can draft the copy once tech confirms supported features.

jordan: Legal checks? eva, any dealbreakers (export controls, crypto export)?

eva: I'll review the partner EULA for embargo clauses and ensure the HSM vendor doesn't restrict exports to certain regions. Also confirm their SOC/ISO attestations if we reference compliance in the listing. Need those docs before publish.

marta: Ops questions: for beta we should create a per-partner namespace and a feature flag to enable verbose KMS logging. Also a time-limited debug token for pilot customers.

liam: Agreed. We'll also run these KMS tests: 
- create key via partner REST API
- wrapKey with our wrap endpoint -> verify ciphertext length and headers
- unwrap and verify original plaintext
- rotate key and ensure old tokens fail
- measure latency P95 under 50 concurrent ops

marta: SCIM test plan (automated): create user, update email, add to group, bulk create 50 users, deprovision user; failure modes: 409 on duplicate, 400 on bad attrs. Sample curl (CI uses this):

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://scim.nexussi.test/v2/Users' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"ci.user","name":{"givenName":"CI","familyName":"User"}}'
```

jordan: Nice. Can eng-oncall get an alert if KMS error rate > 3% during beta? We should avoid noisy thresholds but be sensitive enough.

marta: I'll add a marketplace partner dashboard with latency and error rate panels and set a PagerDuty rule to page for >3% persistent error over 5m. Channel will be #eng-oncall.

dev-bot: ticket created: PARTNERS-6123 "NexusSI marketplace listing & KMS/SCIM certification" assigned to marta,liam :white_check_mark:

tanya: Draft blurb (for review): "Redwood and NexusSI partner to provide HSM-backed key management and SCIM provisioning out-of-the-box for enterprise teams. Certified connector available in the Redwood Marketplace."

jordan: Tweak: add "self-serve onboarding" if SCIM automated onboarding is supported. eva will you approve the compliance phrase once you see attestations?

eva: Yes. Replace "certified" with "Redwood-verified" only after lab report is uploaded. Also request that marketing link to the partner security attestations.

liam: One more item: document the supported algorithms (AES-KW, RSA-OAEP) and max key sizes. We'll include that in the technical metadata for the listing.

marta: I'll capture supported features, known limitations (KMIP out-of-scope v1, retry policy default 2, timeout 5s), onboarding steps, and test report link in the docpack.

jordan: Owners & timeline (proposed): 
- Partner HSM access: partnerships -> request today
- KMS lab tests & report: liam -> 2027-02-15
- SCIM CI & report: marta -> 2027-02-12
- Marketplace listing draft: tanya + marta -> 2027-02-18
- Legal attestation review: eva -> 2027-02-20

marta: ack. I'll post the CI job link when the suite is ready.

liam: kicking off lab once access is granted. cc eng-sre for perf baselines.

jordan: Thanks team. We'll aim for a soft launch to two pilot customers before public listing. Follow-ups in 4 business days. :rocket:
